title: UI Navigation Consolidation Foundation
goal: Reduce operator context switching by consolidating evidence and dossier review into the surfaces where operators already make decisions.
scope: Implement the first navigation-consolidation slice by embedding Evidence Replay context into Finding Theater and moving the run dossier value from Explorer into Report Center or an adjacent run-context tab. Preserve existing API contracts and evidence provenance.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found navigation consolidation was only implicit, not a decision-complete queued package.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Consolidate navigation only where existing data already supports the target surface. Do not delete evidence, report, or dossier capabilities.
notes: The goal is fewer decision surfaces, not loss of auditability.
Any legacy route kept for compatibility must point operators to the consolidated surface.

success_criteria: Finding Theater can show the relevant evidence context needed to review a finding.
Report Center or an adjacent run-context view shows the practical run dossier context operators need.
The active shell presents fewer high-friction navigation choices for the same decision flow.
Browser tests cover finding evidence review and report/dossier review after consolidation.
Existing evidence provenance and report exports remain intact.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Navigation consolidation is visible in the browser.
Evidence and dossier context remain evidence-backed.
No runtime behavior or finding schema changes are introduced.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
The exact surfaces to consolidate are confirmed from current UI behavior.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with navigation consolidation changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the consolidated navigation baseline and remaining UI limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
